worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.summary: Grab an adjacent opponent, deal one Fighting contact hit, then throw it over your shoulder to land behind you; the landing makes one action interrupt, and an opponent with a reserve is truly switched out.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.use.0: Throw an opponent that rushed you over your shoulder
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.use.1: Counter in melee and clear an opponent out of your face
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.use.2: Slam a sturdy target out of melee and hit it on the way
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.descriptio: Grab one opponent within %2$s blocks with a clear line and, on a hit, slam it for about %1$s Fighting contact damage; if it leaves grab range or the slam misses, nothing is thrown.

On a hit the opponent is thrown over your head to land about %1$s blocks behind you on the far side, peaking around %2$s blocks high over %3$s seconds; the arc advances from its actual position each tick and lands in place when terrain blocks it.

The landing makes one action interrupt on the target and attempts a forced switch; a target that resists being carried only takes the slam and is not thrown. This move no longer clears its target over time.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.tight.on: Tight grip on: slam x1.1 and grab reach x0.92 (must be closer), at the cost of x0.8 throw distance.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.tight.off: Tight grip off: throw distance x1.3 and slightly longer reach, at the cost of slam x0.95.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.growth.0: At level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.growth.1: At level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s and the throw reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.preference: On: slam x1.1 and grab reach x0.92 (you must be closer), with throw distance x0.8. Off: throw distance x1.3 and slightly longer reach, with slam x0.95.
The companion only considers a circle throw on a threat within this distance; closer ranks higher, farther goes to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to grab. Off: it only does so when the target is already in reach.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.descriptio: After landing, a thrown opponent that has an available reserve is forced out and the reserve enters at the landing spot; a wild or reserve-less target only stays there and then seeks enemies normally again.
